stats.candidate_archive_scope: nondominated replayed complete candidates encountered, not global Pareto frontier

memory_scope: isolated process peak including input, preprocessing, planning and replay

compression.signature: all absolute frames; exact cell IDs including frame 0 and special-bin labels
compression.grouping: fixed conservative full-column equivalence; not depth-adaptive
compression.floating_order: group aggregation may change rounding; original-ID replay remains required
